A useful limit

def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1

    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b

    return a

Theorem

For $x \ne 0$, $$ \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1. $$

Proof

We begin with the squeeze theorem... $$ \cos x \leq \frac{\sin x}{x} \leq 1. $$ Therefore, taking the limit gives the result.
